correctness.rationale: A direct exact Fourier expansion of Hermitian lifted intensities yields two independently invertible first-harmonic equations, two independent real second-harmonic projections iff sin(2phi) != 0, and one free diagonal dimension. Its nonzero generator is invertible, disjoint from all rank <=2 rank-one differences. Degenerate cases have explicit polynomial pairs. A continuity/determinant argument proves a seven-measurement impossibility for C^3. Gaussian Fourier integral gives the two-channel reduction. Actual finite checker tested ranks, degeneracies, null matrix and convolution Fourier identity. No finite test is substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: A balanced equal-budget design for two sensing channels achieves the known optimal 8-point lower bound, whereas the prior explicit 5+3 design spends five acquisitions in one channel. The result gives an exact experimentally actionable angular-staggering criterion, a sharp aligned-grid counterexample and a two-Gaussian-channel three-tone specialization; the specific equal-budget constraint is motivated independently of the computation.
